name: AP2127K-3.3TRG1
title: 300 mA low-noise CMOS LDO regulator
summary: The AP2127 is a positive linear regulator in CMOS for loads up to 300 mA, running from 2.5 V to 6 V. It holds its output within ±2 %, drops 170 mV at 300 mA on the 3.3 V version, draws 60 µA with no load and 0.1 µA when shut down, and is stable with 1 µF ceramic capacitors. It has current limit, short-circuit foldback, thermal shutdown, a 50 µs soft start and an output discharge switch, and comes in fixed voltages from 1.0 V to 4.75 V or adjustable from 0.8 V, in SOT-23, SOT-23-3, SOT-23-5 and SOT-89.
key_figures: 68 dB at 1 kHz, 54 dB at 10 kHz

pins.name: Shutdown
pins.function: Enable input, active high: above 1.5 V the regulator runs, below 0.5 V it is off. An internal 3 MΩ resistor pulls it down.

pins.name: NC/ADJ
pins.function: Fixed-output versions: no connection. Adjustable version: feedback input, taken from a resistor divider across the output; the regulator holds it at 0.8 V.

circuits.title: Typical application, adjustable version
circuits.description: The SOT-23-5 adjustable regulator with a 1 µF ceramic capacitor on each side. R1 and R2 divide the output down to the ADJ pin, which the loop holds at 0.8 V, so VOUT = 0.8 × (1 + R1/R2). The Shutdown pin is a separate logic input that turns the regulator on when high.

parts.note: upper divider resistor, VOUT to ADJ
lower divider resistor, ADJ to ground

circuits.title: Typical application, fixed-output versions
circuits.description: A fixed-output regulator in SOT-23-5 needs only a 1 µF capacitor from VIN to ground and another from VOUT to ground. The Shutdown pin is driven as a logic input; pin 4 is left open.

circuits.title: Adjustable version with feed-forward capacitor
circuits.description: The adjustable regulator with Cf across R1, from VOUT to the ADJ node, which improves stability and lowers output noise. The input has 1 µF and the output 4.7 µF to ground. Table values pair R1, R2 and Cf for common output voltages, and Cf is picked so that 1/(2π × R1 × Cf) falls between 0.7 kHz and 15 kHz.

operation.text: Fixed outputs of 1.0, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8, 2.5, 2.8, 3.0, 3.3, 4.2 and 4.75 V, and an adjustable version settable from 0.8 V to 5.5 V. SOT-23, SOT-23-3 and SOT-89 carry fixed versions only and have no Shutdown pin; SOT-23-5 carries both, with Shutdown on pin 3.

Pulling Shutdown low turns the regulator off; standby supply current is then 0.1 µA typical. In parts with the Shutdown pin a MOSFET of about 60 Ω connects VOUT to GND while off, so the output capacitors are emptied quickly.
The output ramps up over about 50 µs at turn-on.

Above the current-limit threshold the output current is clamped, protecting the regulator and the load from overheating. The output can supply at least 300 mA (400 mA typical) before it falls to 98 % of its set value.
With VOUT shorted to GND the output current folds back to roughly 50 mA.
An internal thermal shutdown trips at about +165 °C with 30 °C of hysteresis. For continuous operation the junction stays at or below +125 °C.
A 1 µF ceramic capacitor goes between VIN and GND, next to the part. Larger values have no upper limit. VIN and GND want wide traces.

The output needs a capacitor to be stable. A 1 µF or larger X5R or X7R ceramic with low ESR holds it stable across the full temperature range; more capacitance reduces overshoot and undershoot on transients. The capacitor sits at the VOUT and GND pins on short leads.
PAD: an exposed thermal pad, connected to GND. It has no pin number in any of the four packages.
The highest output qualified is 4.75 V; curves taken at VOUT = 5.2 V are for reference only.
